sources.snippet: LeRobot is a state-of-the-art AI robotics library developed by Hugging Face, adapted by Hiwonder for educational and research purposes. It provides models, datasets, and tools for real-world robotics in PyTorch.

sources.title: Manibar ACT ERC Black Switches - Physical AI Dataset | Claru
sources.snippet: A robotics manipulation dataset for black switch interaction tasks collected using the ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) framework. The dataset contains 81 episodes with multi-modal observations including RGB images and proprioceptive state data.

sources.title: Action Chunking with Transformers - ACT — Open Edge Platform Documentation
sources.snippet: Action Chunking with Transformers - ACT # Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an end-to-end imitation learning model designed for fine manipulation tasks in robotics, learned directly from real demonstrations.
